name: realytica
description: Realytica — AI-powered Property Intelligence. Local-first MVP: Realytica Property Screen.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/agents && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.probe:model: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/probe-model.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/probe-model.mjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.cache/probe-model.mjs
scripts.eval: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/run-eval.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/run-eval.mjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.cache/run-eval.mjs
scripts.eval:multilingual: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && esbuild scripts/eval-multilingual.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/eval-multilingual.mjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.cache/eval-multilingual.mjs
